description: This file defines the 'TaxRate' controller class within the OpenCart admin localization module. It handles CRUD operations and rendering views for tax rate management in the admin panel.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class managing the tax rate entities in the admin panel, including listing, form handling, saving, and deletion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the list view of tax rates and set up the page layout.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers the rendering of the tax rate list without additional layout.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of tax rates, prepares data for the list view, and returns the rendered HTML.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a tax rate, pre-filling data if editing an existing record.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated tax rate data, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tax rate entries after permission and dependency checks, and returns success/error JSON.
